name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A frigid globe bursts in a 60-foot radius: Con save, 10d6 Cold, half on a success.
text: Water it hits freezes solid for a minute. Instead of throwing it, you can keep the globe to hurl later or hand it to someone; it bursts if dropped or thrown up to 40 ft.
